Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: Treated CNRS Éditions’ “professeur à l’Université de la Méditerranée depuis 2007” as conflicting with Berggruen’s “professor in Marseille … since 2000,” conflating a specific university appointment (2007) with the start of working in France (2000). This misinterpretation introduced an incorrect competing year and risked leading to the wrong final answer.
